name: Galaxy USDT Quality
oneLiner: Galaxy USDT Quality is a Galaxy-curated Morpho V2 USDT lending vault; shares accrue interest, absorb losses, and redeem subject to liquidity.
collateral: USDT-denominated idle balances and lender positions in Galaxy-curated Morpho markets. Borrower collateral, valuation and market liquidity vary; the share does not represent cash held solely at the parent issuer.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposits exchange USDT for NAV-bearing shares. Borrower interest and configured fee-share accrual change assets per share; realized lending losses can reduce NAV. Withdraw/redeem burns shares for idle USDT and liquidity from the configured adapter; force-deallocation is separate and cannot create liquidity in fully borrowed markets.

VaultV2 exit code burns shares against available assets and recognizes losses; holder exposure differs from the fiat-cash parent. One adapter 0x0b4bcdd43778df87befb011a27debf5e48a78b71 enumerates 4 current market IDs; summed expectedSupplyAssets=11026140085669, idle underlying=249636976; their sum equals totalAssets. All current positions have zero borrow shares and zero posted collateral. This is an operational proportional lending-position claim. It is not direct ownership of the parent issuer reserve, an independently signed financial reconciliation, or proof of legal segregation and insolvency priority.
